Irene V.: Quick postmortem follow-up: Saturday ingest backlog caused delayed token reporting for ~300 accounts. Need owners for credits, detection automation, and customer comms.

Marco D.: I can own the credits ledger updates + runbook for invoice patches. Can someone produce a per-account delta CSV?

Nina S.: Ran a reconcile job this morning, attached results to vault. Early numbers: ~950k missed tokens, est $9.5k. Upload: vault://finance/reconciles/2265432100/summary.csv

Ops Bot: Reconcile job id rj-2265-01 completed. flagged_accounts=301, total_missed_tokens=948712, est_credit_usd=$9487.12. artifact:s3://redwood-prod/ingest/2265432100/preview.csv

Marco D.: Thx. Proposal: auto-credit when credit < $30 USD, manual review for >= $30. Works? Need finance+legal approval.

Legal: We'll review thresholds. Please include language that credits don't alter contractual terms and retain dispute path.

Nina S.: For detection we should add an hourly reconcile that alerts when daily delta ratio > 0.8%. Suggest rule: daily_missed / daily_reported > 0.008 triggers an alert.

Irene V.: Agreed. Owner for monitoring ticket?

Marco D.: I'll open a ticket and assign to eng-monitoring. ETA for alert: 48h.

Nina S.: Also found recurring pattern: spikes correlate with broker GC windows at ~03:00 UTC. Ops should add a runbook entry.

Irene V.: Omar from infra is on the postmortem; Omar, can infra add guardrails around consumer restarts?

Ops Bot: Infra ticket INF-5060 created for safer consumer restart policy, SLA 7 days.

Marco D.: Action list: 1) Marco  credits + invoice patch runbook (due 2026-04-05) 2) Nina  final reconcile CSV + detection rule PR (due 2026-03-29) 3) Infra/INF-5060  durable restart changes (due 2026-04-06) 4) Legal  comms wording review (due 2026-03-30).

Irene V.: Can we fast-track credits for accounts > $200? Customers impacted heavily deserve priority. Marco please queue those first.

Marco D.: Will prioritize >$200. Scheduling a dry run tomorrow 09:00 PT.

Legal: Reviewed sample comms, small edits suggested. Will post annotated version in doc.

Irene V.: Thanks team. We'll track progress on the billing PM board and review in next billing sync. :white_check_mark:
